library(dplyr)

```{r}
setwd("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/10 global mapping/2 global mapping/")
```

```{r}
hlhs <- readRDS("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/6 hlhs clean global object/HLHS_cleaned_normalized_annotated.rds")
DimPlot(hlhs, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, group.by = "global.type")
```

```{r}
hlhs <- RunSPCA(hlhs, assay = 'SCT', graph = 'SCT_snn')
DimPlot(hlhs, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, group.by = "global.type")
```

```{r}
mpab <- readRDS("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/10 global mapping/1 mouse pab human genes/humangenes_mpab.rds")
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, group.by = "global.type", split.by = "condition")
```




```{r}
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = hlhs,
  query = mpab,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  reference.assay = "SCT",
  dims = 1:40
)
```




```{r}
mpab <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  query = mpab,
  reference = hlhs,
  refdata = list(
    celltype = "global.type"
  ),
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  reduction.model = "umap"
)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(mpab, "./mpab_hlhs_mapped.rds")
```

```{r}
mpab <- readRDS("./mpab_hlhs_mapped.rds")
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = 'predicted.celltype', split.by = "condition", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Idents(mpab) <- "predicted.celltype"
mpab.averageexpression <- AverageExpression(mpab, features = c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast'), assays = "prediction.score.celltype")

mpab.averageexpression <- as.matrix(mpab.averageexpression)
mapping_scores <- mpab.averageexpression[[1]]

list <- c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast')

png(filename="./mapping scores mpab hlhs heatmap.png", width = 30, height = 30, units ="cm", res =300)
pheatmap(mapping_scores[,list], color=colorRampPalette(c("#0D0887FF", "#7E03A8FF", "#CC4678FF", "#F89441FF", "#F0F921FF"))(50), scale="none", cellheight = 30, cellwidth = 30, cexCol=0.5, cluster_rows=FALSE, fontsize_row=25, fontsize_col=25, cluster_cols = FALSE, legend = TRUE, fontsize = 20)
dev.off()
```




#mapping scores with query identities 

```{r}
Idents(mpab) <- "global.type"
mpab.averageexpression <- AverageExpression(mpab, features = c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast'), assays = "prediction.score.celltype")

mpab.averageexpression <- as.matrix(mpab.averageexpression)

mapping_scores <- mpab.averageexpression[[1]]



list <- c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatics', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'epicardium')

png(filename="./mapping scores mpab hlhs query heatmap.png", width = 30, height = 30, units ="cm", res =300)
pheatmap(mapping_scores[,list], color=colorRampPalette(c("#0D0887FF", "#7E03A8FF", "#CC4678FF", "#F89441FF", "#F0F921FF"))(50), scale="none", cellheight = 30, cellwidth = 30, cexCol=0.5, cluster_rows=FALSE, fontsize_row=25, fontsize_col=25, cluster_cols = FALSE, legend = TRUE, fontsize = 20)
dev.off()
```




```{r}
mpab$condition <- factor(x = mpab$condition, levels = c('normal', 'moderate', 'severe'))
```

```{r}
mpab$predicted.celltype <- factor(x = mpab$predicted.celltype, levels = c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast'))
```

```{r}
png(filename="./mpab_hlhs_mapped_dimplot.png", width=25, height=20, units="cm", res=600)
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "ref.umap", label = FALSE, group.by = "predicted.celltype", pt.size = 1) + coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=25))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#920000","#004949","#009292","#ff6db6","#490092","#006ddb","#24ff24","#db6d00","#b66dff","#6db6ff","#ffff6d","#ffb6db","#b6dbff","#924900"))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(filename="./mpab_hlhs_mapped_dimplot_condition.png", width=60, height=20, units="cm", res=600)
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "ref.umap", label = FALSE, group.by = "predicted.celltype", pt.size = 1, split.by = "condition") + coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=25))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#920000","#004949","#009292","#ff6db6","#490092","#006ddb","#24ff24","#db6d00","#b66dff","#6db6ff","#ffff6d","#ffb6db","#b6dbff","#924900"))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(filename="./mpab_hlhs_mapped_barplot.png", width=40, height=20, units="cm", res=600)
ggplot(mpab@meta.data, aes(x = condition, fill = predicted.celltype)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.95) +
  xlab("Sample") +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())+ coord_fixed(ratio=5)  +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#920000","#004949","#009292","#ff6db6","#490092","#006ddb","#24ff24","#db6d00","#b66dff","#6db6ff","#ffff6d","#ffb6db","#b6dbff","#924900"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=25))+ 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 25))
dev.off()
```


#markerlist
```{r}
DefaultAssay(mpab) <- 'RNA'
Idents(mpab) <- "predicted.celltype"
rna.markers <- FindAllMarkers(mpab, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(rna.markers, file ="./humangenes_mpab_markerlist_predictedcelltype.csv", quote = FALSE)
```
